summary: Third-party API (TranscriptAPI) that returns YouTube video transcripts, search and channel data.
access_note: Sign up and get a free API key; 100 free credits, no card, then $5/month for 1,000 credits.

evidence.quote: The API uses Bearer token authentication.
new accounts get 100 free credits, no card required
extract playlists via REST API or YouTube MCP

notes: Small third-party vendor, not affiliated with YouTube; data likely sourced unofficially from YouTube, so continuity and ToS risk exist. Base URL https://transcriptapi.com/api/v2 with GET endpoints. The hosted MCP page offers OAuth and API-key sign-in; the REST API itself documents only a Bearer API key.
